fields.name: phrase
fields.label: Search Phrase
fields.description: Optional productSearch phrase (empty = all matching filter)

fields.name: subtitle
fields.label: Subtitle
fields.description: Optional. Enables the side-title layout (left panel beside the slider). Example: What our customers love!

fields.name: show-all-text
fields.label: Show All Text
fields.description: Optional side-title link label, e.g. Show all

fields.name: attribute
fields.label: Attribute
fields.description: Catalog Service productSearch filter attribute. Examples: isNew, categoryIds

fields.name: eq
fields.label: Equals
fields.description: Filter equality value. Examples: 1 (for isNew), 6 (for categoryIds)
